experiments.title: PDF p25: 10 V divider-bias example
experiments.note: Exact resistor/supply values from Example 5–2. Textbook neglects base loading and fixes VBE=0.7 V (VCE≈1.95 V); the finite-beta SPICE model need not match that approximation exactly.

experiments.title: PDF p110: practical integrator example
experiments.note: Exact 10k/200k/0.047uF, 1 kHz and ±2.5 V from Example 13–10. Ideal slope −5319.15 V/s; real LM358 and finite feedback resistance included.

experiments.title: PDF p113: differentiator example
experiments.note: Exact 2.2k/150ohm/0.001uF and ±5 V triangle at 100 kHz from Example 13–11. Uses explicitly idealized op-amp for the textbook ±4.4 V prediction; does not validate a real op-amp at this speed.
